short_title: Who's lying? Can you solve it? 🕵️ #shorts
short_description:
Who's Lying? #1 — A rare gold coin vanished during a museum gala in New York, on December 21st at 8 p.m. Four suspects, four alibis… one of them is impossible. Comment the number of the liar 👇 The answer (and the science behind it) is in the next video.

Synthetic voice, original illustrations. Fictional story.

comment: 🕵️ Who's lying: 1, 2, 3 or 4? Comment your answer, the reveal is in the next video 👇
solution: 3 — the photographer: in New York on December 21st, the sun sets around 4:30 p.m. (EST), so there is no sunset to shoot at 8 p.m.
